messages:
elaine_sales: Heads-up: Luminara Health is asking for a presales capacity sketch. Soft commit range 4.5-5.8M tokens/day, require reserved GPUs, burst credits, monthly spend cap, and HIPAA/SOC2 artifacts. Need conservative + optimistic plan and commercial language by EOD. @mark_presales @tony_eng

mark_presales: Traffic excerpt: baseline ~38 rps weekdays, short morning spike ~3.2x for 20m, occasional afternoon microbursts. Median output ~95 tokens, p95 ~210. They want AZ spread, BYOK/KMS, and a canary rollout.

tony_eng: Quick back-of-envelope: use midpoint 5.15M tokens/day. Estimate requests/day = 5,150,000 / 95 ≈ 54,210 req/day → avg ~0.63 req/sec. Peak rps (3.2x) -> ~121.6 rps. Peak token throughput (use p95 210) = 121.6 * 210 ≈ 25,536 tokens/sec.

tony_eng: GPU throughput buckets: conservative 8k tps, baseline 10k tps, optimistic 14k tps. GPUs_needed_cons = ceil(25536/8000)=4, baseline=ceil(25536/10000)=3, opt=ceil(25536/14000)=2. Recommendation: reserved commit = 4 GPUs (covers baseline conservative + 1 AZ buffer). Add burst escrow = 2 GPUs available for short windows. If customer accepts quantized 8-bit variant, could reduce reserved to 2-3 GPUs but highlight quality validation required.

mark_presales: Proposed autoscale: min_instances=2, scale_target_util=68%, scale_step=+1, cooldown=90s, max_instances=7, burst_pool=2, prewarm_seconds=300. Canary: 3% for 10m → 15% for 20m → 50% for 30m → full. Rollback if tail_latency >2x SLO or error_rate >1%.

sara_sre: KV/Prefix warmup plan: schedule a 12-minute bake before morning peak running representative prompts at 1.5 rps per instance for 10 minutes to populate KV. Snapshot KV post-canary. Health checks: kv_hit_rate, p99_latency_ms, gpu_util_pct, queue_depth. Runbook snippet: if p99_latency > 2x SLO for 3m -> enable burst pool, throttle non-critical routes, and if no recovery in 5m escalate to cross-AZ shift.

greg_fin: Commercial proposal ideas: Tier A = Commit 4 GPUs monthly + 2 GPU-hour/day burst escrow + 18% reserved discount for 12-mo. Tier B = Commit 6 GPUs + 4 GPU-hour/day burst + 22% discount + faster SLA. Monthly cap = committed spend + explicit capped burst overage bucket; unused burst hours rollover up to monthly cap. Include quarterly usage review and growth adjustment clause.

sec_bot: presales-pack/luminara/reqs_uploaded.pdf uploaded by mark_presales at 1780011200

tony_eng: Quick inline calc I'll include in the one-pager:
```
peak_rps = 38 * 3.2  # ≈121.6
peak_tps = peak_rps * 210  # ≈25536 tokens/sec
gpu_tps = 10000  # baseline
gpus_needed = ceil(25536 / gpu_tps)  # = 3 (baseline)
reserve_recommend = 4
burst_pool = 2
```

mark_presales: Action items: 1) Tony - generate 1p capacity calc PDF with conservative and optimistic scenarios + quantization caveat by COB. 2) Mark - draft autoscale JSON, canary windows, and rollback criteria. 3) Sara - security artifact pack + runbook excerpts for AZ failover and KV warmup. 4) Greg - commercial term language for cap, rollover, burst escrow, and discount tiers. Target: assemble presales pack and send Luminara tomorrow AM; security Q answers within 3 business days.

elaine_sales: Thanks team — prioritize conservative numbers for legal. We'll flag quantization as optional on acceptance testing. Reconvene after docs uploaded. :thumbsup:
